# Character scope (the caster); targeted spells have the target as scope:recipient.

aov_spell_combat_ward_cast = {
	custom_tooltip = aov_spell_combat_ward_cost_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		aov_mana_spend = { AMOUNT = aov_spell_combat_ward_cost }
		aov_school_add_progress = { SCHOOL = abjuration AMOUNT = 25 }
		add_magic_lifestyle_xp = 25
		set_variable = { name = aov_spell_combat_ward_cd years = aov_spell_combat_ward_years }
	}
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_spell_combat_ward years = aov_spell_combat_ward_years }
}

	hidden_effect = {
		aov_mana_spend = { AMOUNT = aov_spell_steal_vitality_cost }
		aov_school_add_progress = { SCHOOL = necromancy AMOUNT = 50 }
		add_magic_lifestyle_xp = 50
		set_variable = { name = aov_spell_steal_vitality_cd years = aov_spell_steal_vitality_years }
	}
	random_list = {
		0 = {
			modifier = { add = aov_spell_land_chance }
			add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_spell_steal_vitality years = aov_spell_steal_vitality_years }
			aov_life_drain = yes
		}
		0 = {
			modifier = { add = aov_spell_miss_chance }
			aov_spell_missed = yes
		}
	}
	aov_dark_magic_roll = yes
}

# Purify: remove every hostile spell's modifier from this character
aov_spell_remove_curses = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_spell_winters_grip_target }
		remove_character_modifier = aov_spell_winters_grip_target
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_spell_phantasmal_rumour_target }
		remove_character_modifier = aov_spell_phantasmal_rumour_target
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_spell_ray_of_sickness_victim }
		remove_character_modifier = aov_spell_ray_of_sickness_victim
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_spell_steal_vitality_victim }
		remove_character_modifier = aov_spell_steal_vitality_victim
	}
}

# Field of Forbiddance: dispel this character's war spells
aov_spell_dispel_war_spells = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_spell_mage_armor }
		remove_character_modifier = aov_spell_mage_armor
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_spell_shock_and_awe }
		remove_character_modifier = aov_spell_shock_and_awe
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_spell_flaming_munitions }
		remove_character_modifier = aov_spell_flaming_munitions
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_spell_meteor_swarm }
		remove_character_modifier = aov_spell_meteor_swarm
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_spell_mass_enlarge }
		remove_character_modifier = aov_spell_mass_enlarge
	}
}
